name: High School Regional Occupational Program (ROP)
what_you_do: Take career classes in several industry sectors at your high school as part of the Merced County ROP. The page links to a program brochure and a Career Industry Day page.
who_can_apply: High school students across Merced County. The page lists the ROP at Delhi, Dos Palos, Gustine, Hilmar, Le Grand, Los Banos and Pacheco high schools. It also lists Merced Scholars Charter School. It also lists Valley Community School in Atwater and in Los Banos. Grade rules are not stated.
pay_detail: Cost, pay and credit are not stated on the page.
deadline_text: No dates are posted on the page.
how_to_apply: The page does not explain how to enroll. Ask your school counselor, or contact Dora Robles, Staff Secretary, at (209) 381-6684 or drobles@mcoe.org.
notes: Confirm first. The page does not list the courses, grades, cost or how to enroll. The MCOE college and career page also lists the EMPOWER program (see the separate EMPOWER card). It also lists Cal-SOAP for college and financial aid information.
